name: Protection relays and substation IEDs
description: Numerical protection relays and IEC 61850 intelligent electronic devices for overcurrent, distance, differential and transformer protection on the Malaysian grid and industrial systems, type-tested to IEC 60255.

specifications.metric: distance protection operating time, SEL-421 high-speed
specifications.basis: SEL-421 high-speed element: 0.8 cycle maximum operating time at 70% of reach and SIR = 1; the standard SEL-421-1 is 1.5 cycles

source.note: SEL-421 data sheet cited from search summary, 2026-11-13

specifications.basis: SEL-421 data sheet: timer accuracy plus/minus 0.125 cycle plus 0.1% of setting; event time stamping better than 10 microseconds

source.note: SEL-421 data sheet cited from search summary, 2026-11-13

specifications.basis: Siemens 7SA513 shortest command time about 11 ms; 7SA86 tripolar minimum about 9 ms; distance function type-tested to IEC 60255-151

source.note: SIPROTEC 7SA technical data cited from search summary, 2026-11-13

specifications.basis: SIPROTEC technical data: IDMT tolerance within 5% plus/minus 15 ms for 2 to 20 x pickup and 1-20 s

source.note: SIPROTEC 7SA technical data cited from search summary, 2026-11-13

specifications.basis: SIPROTEC 7SA supports IEC 61850 Ed1/Ed2.1 and IEC 61850-9-2 process bus with PTP time sync; new substations in Malaysia follow IEC 61850

specifications.metric: fault duty protection must clear at 500 kV
indicative cost, single-function overcurrent relay (export price list)
specifications.basis: Export price list, accepted as the price basis on owner instruction 2026-11-13. A 2026 microprocessor-relay price guide covering 96 manufacturers and 560 SKUs puts single-function overcurrent devices at about USD 120 through Chinese OEM channels, rising with function count and brand tier.

source.note: Microprocessor protection relay price and cost guide 2026, read via browser search 2026-11-13

specifications.metric: indicative cost, full IEC 61850 bay-controller IED (export price list)
specifications.basis: Same price guide: the spread reaches USD 12,000+ for a full IEC 61850 bay controller from Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories or GE Grid Solutions. Function class, brand tier and certification drive the 30x spread the source documents.
